# Experiments with Google

> > A showcase of creative projects exploring web technology, AI, accessibility, and interactive experiences built with Google tools and technologies.

Experiments with Google features innovative projects from Google Creative Lab, partners, and the community that push the boundaries of what's possible with Chrome, machine learning, WebGL, and assistive technologies. The platform highlights both cutting-edge technical demonstrations and inclusive design tools that make creativity accessible to everyone.

## Key Topics

- Chrome Experiments
- WebGL
- Machine Learning & AI
- Accessibility & Assistive Technology
- Creative Coding
- Google Creative Lab
- Interactive Experiments
- Music Visualization
- Adaptive Design
- Browser Technology
- Eye Gaze Communication
- Motor Impairments Support
- Community Projects
- Web Technology Innovation
- AutoDraw & QuickDraw

## Accessibility & Inclusive Design

- [Start With One](https://lm-studio.experiments.withgoogle.com/collection/startwithone): Accessibility-focused experiments including Look to Speak & adaptive tools
- [Creatability](https://lm-studio.experiments.withgoogle.com/collection/creatability): Creatability accessible creative tools for music & drawing with AI

## AI & Machine Learning Tools

- [AutoDraw](https://shop.experiments.withgoogle.com/autodraw): AutoDraw AI drawing tool using QuickDraw machine learning technology

## Chrome & Web Technology Experiments

- [Chrome Experiments](https://lm-studio.experiments.withgoogle.com/collection/chrome): Chrome Experiments showcase featuring WebGL, creative coding projects
